arguments.value: Summary: Boyd Enterprises agreed to produce at least 40 episodes of Honey Hole per year and give Cano Petroleum exclusive lead sponsorship rights, including prominent on-air promotions, signage at public appearances, logo placement on the show’s boat and vehicle, and featured guest appearances. In return, Cano would pay Boyd $150,000 total in four equal installments during 2008. The agreement runs from January 1 to December 31, 2008, requires written notice for official communications, is governed by Texas law with venue in Tarrant County/Fort Worth, and includes standard terms on taxes, force majeure, attorney’s fees, assignment limits, exclusivity of the contract, and liability limitations.
